answer: Forging thousands of fake identities becomes costly because every sybil needs its own stake, and slashing burns it on proven fraud. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond of real value before voting or earning, and reputation accrues only through verified work across epochs. Like a tide that erodes counterfeit ground, the bond threshold rises with network size. No fable of free influence survives; legitimate contributors accumulate timber-grade reputation that attackers cannot fake cheaply. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
